partNotes.scene_script_jump_table: 24-entry word jump table mapping scene opcode indices ($00–$17) to handler addresses. Unused slots ($00–$01, $07–$0D, $0F, $12, $16) point to SceneCmd_Default (RTS no-op). Active handlers: $02=SceneCmd_ConfigDisplay, $03=SceneCmd_LoadBgTiles, $04=SceneCmd_LoadPalette, $05=SceneCmd_LoadMetatileSets, $06=SceneCmd_LoadLayerMaps, $0E=SceneCmd_Skip3, $10=SceneCmd_LoadSpriteTiles, $11=SpcMusicLoadCmd, $13=SceneCmd_Branch, $14=SceneCmd_Label, $15=SkipScriptCommands, $17=SceneCmd_LoadCharTiles.
partNotes.SceneCmd_Label: Scene command $14: label definition, executed as a no-op. Skips the label id operand (INY) and ends at the RTS of SceneCmd_Default that follows; the id is not used here. The position of the label in the stream is what jump ($15) and branch ($13, flag set) continue at.
partNotes.SceneCmd_LoadPalette: Scene command $04: load palette colours into the palette buffer. Reads three script operands (start, end, destination colour), each doubled (ASL) into $0664/$0666/$0668 (colour index to byte offset), loads the source pointer via LoadScriptPointer, then DmaRomToWram copies the window [start, end) of the source to $7F:0A00 + destination. Special case: destination $0020 (colour $10) also copies the first colour just loaded, from $7F0A20, to cgramPalette (colour 0, the backdrop) after the DMA.
partNotes.SceneCmd_LoadMetatileSets: Scene command $05: load a metatile definition set into WRAM for layer 0, layer 1 or both from one shared source. Reads three window operands (start, end, destination), each scaled by XBA + LSR×2 (x$40) into $0664/$0666/$0668, then a flags byte into $066A (bit 0 = layer 0, bit 1 = layer 1) and the source pointer. Each flagged layer is checked against its source cache slot ($0678/$067B); a cache hit clears that layer bit. If any layer remains: decompress once to $7E:7000, then for each remaining layer DMA the window to $7E:2000 (layer 0) or $7E:2800 (layer 1) + destination and call BuildMetatileFlagTable.
partNotes.SceneCmd_LoadLayerMaps: Scene command $06: load the layer map or maps (width, height and compressed map). Reads flags $066A and source pointer; optionally clears layer bits on source cache hits ($067E layer 0, $0681 layer 1). Reads map width/height pairs into $00/$01 (X) and $02/$03 (Y). If no layers active after cache filtering, returns early. With active layers but zero geometry (compressed pointer $0000), HandleEmptyGeometry. With nonzero geometry: StoreMapAndDecompress per active layer; layer 1 also copies primary decompressed data from $A000 to $C000 and stores secondary map dimensions. If flags indicate no tilemap layers (AND #$7F == 0), DmaLowVramTileset loads tiles directly to low VRAM.
partNotes.SpcMusicLoadCmd: Load SPC music data when the script's group equals musicRoomGroup. Reads musicParentActor and the group byte from the script (the group byte is stored at $06F4 at the top of the routine), loads the ROM pointer, then compares musicRoomGroup to $06F4: equal continues to the load path, a mismatch returns. CheckSourceCacheHit on $0687 skips a repeated load of the same source. On load: WaitFrames(26), optional stop ($F2 + 32 frames if $0D72 set), handshake ($F0 poll, $FF), SpcBlockTransfer from $46/$48, sets $0D72=1, then writes play ($01) or stop ($00) to APUIO0 based on musicParentActor.
